project_overview.project_summary: This business operations project centers on Data flow mapping for CRM. The formal job description is sparse, so the conversation and delivered artifacts are the primary evidence for reconstructing the engagement. The work sits mainly in CRM and sales automation, Data analytics and reporting, Data Science & Analytics. Stable project themes include crm lead management, workflow automation, analytics and reporting, outbound communication. The available evidence includes 617 conversation messages, 2 deliverable files, which together document the brief, collaboration, review cycle, and delivered work. The recoverable artifacts span .png formats; their contents were used only where they supplied stable domain, production, architecture, or handoff information. For onboarding, the key task is to understand the intended audience, source assets, production workflow, review loop, delivery formats, and constraints that determine acceptance. No inspectable software repository was identified, so technical details are limited to what the brief, conversation, and artifacts explicitly establish.
